report: Revision Kohn-Sham cross-check: Rust solver vs the independent Python reference (different discretisation) on the FULL canonical matrix
tolerance_rule: |x_Rust - x_ref| <= 3 (U_ref + U_Rust) + 1e-12 scale; U_ref = the reference's three-grid Richardson uncertainty (validated on a fourth grid); U_Rust = (16/15) |canonical - refined| measured per state (checker/rust-refinement.json) or, where `single` does not report the quantity, the matrix-wide maximum of ks-rust-determinism.json or a stated propagation of measured uncertainties; |single - matrix| is added where the two take different SCF paths (exact-Fock variant); scale = max(1, |x|) for scalars, the profile maximum for profiles. Fixed before the comparison.

checks.name: inputs_all_pass
checks.detail: reference report 39/39 PASS, Rust solver report 45/45 PASS, Rust determinism report 14/14 PASS; failing checks: {'ks-reference.json': [], 'ks-rust-solver.json': [], 'ks-rust-determinism.json': []}; Rust refinement runs (single canonical and refined) failed: none; the refinement covers every state of the Rust matrix: True (states per kind: Rust {'ground': 75, 'thermo': 135, 'exx': 60, 'crossing': 5}, measured {'ground': 75, 'thermo': 135, 'exx': 60, 'crossing': 5})

checks.name: rust_refinement_applies_to_matrix
checks.detail: the canonical `single` runs of checker/rust-refinement.json reproduce the committed canonical matrix (tolerance 1e-12 for every class; crossing demonstration relative to max(1, |E|)): E_KS_rel 0.000e+00, E_aufbau_abs_rel 0.000e+00, E_continued_abs_rel 3.957e-16, E_rel 0.000e+00, emt_integrals_rel 0.000e+00, entropy_rel 0.000e+00, levels_max_abs 0.000e+00, mu_abs 0.000e+00, profiles_max_rel 0.000e+00; hence |canonical - refined| of these runs measures the error of the committed Rust results

checks.name: rust_refinement_applies_to_matrix_exx
checks.detail: exact-Fock variant: the matrix and `single --exx` solve it at the occupations of the converged uniform-gas ground state, started from it (the same path); both stop at max |residual| <= scfTolerance = 1e-11: |E_single - E_matrix| <= N x scfTolerance and |gap_single - gap_matrix| <= 6 scfTolerance (two levels, three potentials) are required; worst ratios: E 0.000 (N8_lamp2_a20 |dE| 0.000e+00), gap 0.000 (N2352_lamm1_a00 |dgap| 2.255e-16); the measured |single - matrix| is added to U_Rust of the exact-Fock comparisons
